summary: PRDocuments class handles the management of placement request documents within a user control environment. It facilitates document uploads, editing, saving, and deletion processes, and is integrated with grid and form view components for displaying and managing document details.
purpose: Manage placement request documents including upload, display, and delete operations in a Web UI context.

workflows.name: Document Handling Workflow
steps: HandleUploadedFile is invoked to process file uploads.
Documents are displayed using gvwDocument grid view.
FormView fvwDocument is used for editing document details.
SaveDocument method saves the document details including file data.
Redirect method is called to refresh the page or redirect after actions.

business_rules: Documents are stored in a specific directory structure using GUIDs for folder names.
Only documents with valid file size and type are processed.
validations: CustomValidator1 is used for custom validation logic.
JavaScript validations for document type and comments.
system_behavior: Uses AJAX ModalPopupExtender for displaying additional details.
Utilizes Grid.View for listing documents and FormView for editing.
